name: Elizabeth Deschaine
public_footprint:
Elizabeth Deschaine of Potsdam, NY, graduated magna cum laude from SUNY Potsdam in 2022 with a B.S. in Biology and was named to the President's List in multiple semesters. A professional profile lists her as a Certified Phlebotomy Technician at Canton Potsdam Hospital and a horseback riding instructor at Deschaine Stables in Potsdam.
Sources: https://meritpages.com/Elizabeth-J-Deschaine/4774276; https://us.bold.pro/my/elizabeth-deschaine-250811195411
